label: Payments and cash transfers
definition: Humanitarian cash, anticipatory cash, remittances, merchant payments, wages.

label: Credit, savings and insurance
definition: Micro-lending, savings tools, parametric insurance, guarantees.

label: Identity, records and data integrity
definition: Digital ID, credentials, provenance, archiving and storage.

label: Supply chain and traceability
definition: Vaccines, food, commodities, tokenised goods.

label: Climate and natural assets
definition: Carbon and environmental credits, regenerative finance, climate data.

label: Governance, funding and coordination
definition: DAOs, community treasuries, crowdfunding, grant and donor flows.

label: None fits
definition: No domain fits; explained in a note. Counts toward taxonomy fit (metric 3).

label: Delivery efficiency
definition: Transaction cost, speed, administrative burden.

label: Reach and access
definition: Adoption, active use, inclusion of women, unbanked people and displaced people.

label: Transparency, trust and accountability
definition: Traceability, leakage, fraud, user trust.

label: Financial resilience and wellbeing
definition: Income, savings, coping, financial stress.

label: Sector outcomes
definition: Health, education, climate adaptation, human rights and justice, culture.

label: Risks, harms and unintended effects
definition: Privacy, volatility, cash-out failure, exclusion, security incidents.

label: Claim
definition: Describes what the solution does and why it should work. No data on results.

label: Operational
definition: Data on outputs, usage or operational performance, with no measure of user outcomes.

label: Outcome, no comparison
definition: Outcome data from participants without a comparison group.

label: Outcome with comparison
definition: Outcomes compared with a comparison group or non-blockchain alternative, without strong identification.

label: Counterfactual impact
definition: Randomised or strong quasi-experimental impact estimate, ideally independent.

label: Descriptive comparison
definition: Descriptive comparison with a prior or alternative channel.

label: Tested comparison
definition: Tested comparison against a non-blockchain alternative.
